issue.title: Update Record Tab for Verse/Pericope Toggle
issue.body: The Record tab's Current Unit Title and draft waveform are currently built around a single, project-fixed recording granularity. With the verse/pericope toggle making the working unit a live per-user setting, both need to switch behavior based on the active mode so it's always unambiguous what unit a translator is about to record. ## Functional Requirements ### Recording Controls - Update the Current Unit Title to reflect the active mode: show a verse reference in verse mode, or the pericope verse range in pericope mode with the pericope title as a subtitle when it is available. - Do not show a "Pericope 1 of 7" style counter in the Current Unit Title. - In verse mode, show verse-level tick marks on the draft waveform with per-verse scrubbing. - In pericope mode, show a continuous scrubber with no tick marks; scrubbing is position-only since verse boundaries are not known.

comments.body:
## Engineering context

### Product intent
Record tab Current Unit Title + draft waveform follow the live Verse/Pericope mode so it’s always clear what unit is about to be recorded.

### What exists today
- Title is verse-only: `` `${chapterName}:${selectedVerse}` `` in `RecordTab` (`record-verse-reference`).
- Prev/next navigates verses, not pericopes.
- Draft waveform: `PlaybackProgressBar` — continuous scrub in review; **no** tick marks.
- Recording stack: `useVerseAudio` keyed by single `bibleTextId` (verse).
- Mode preference: #407; pericope data: not on mobile yet.

### Alignment notes
- Spec: verse mode → verse reference; pericope mode → verse **range** + optional pericope title subtitle; never `"Pericope 1 of 7"`.
- Spec: verse-mode draft waveform shows **verse-level** tick marks with per-verse scrubbing; pericope mode stays continuous with **no** ticks (verse boundaries unknown on the draft take). That matches “don’t invent boundaries.”
- Title/mode UI can land before mixed-mode persistence (#410), but navigation + which `bibleTextId`(s) get recorded must stay coherent — don’t imply pericope capture until #410 defines storage.

### Suggested approach
1. Read drafting-unit preference (#407) in Record tab / shared drafting context.
2. Resolve active unit (verse vs pericope group from synced pericopes).
3. Update reference header + optional subtitle; adjust prev/next to unit boundaries.
4. Waveform: add optional tick markers only in verse mode when we have meaningful boundaries for the **draft** surface — confirm with design; do not fake pericope ticks.

### Dependencies
- **Requires:** #407, mobile pericope sync (same foundation as #408).
- **Does not require:** #412 for title work; player chrome is separate.
- **Before claiming full pericope recording:** #410 (and range-take upload support on fluent-api `/verse-audio`, which is verse-keyed today).

### API
- Same pericope sync / full-range needs as #408.
- No separate Record-tab API for titles.
- Uploading pericope takes is **not** this ticket — see #410.

### Out of scope
- Mixed-mode take coexistence / labels / 5-cap (#410)
- Cross-granularity stitch playback (#411)
- Source-audio dock ticks (#408)

**Blocked on:** [#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438) — Sync pericope boundaries to local SQLite (data model + post-login sync).

That ticket covers schema, `FluentAPI.getChapterPericopes`, repository writes, sync step, and offline queries. Implement #438 (or land it first) before pericope-mode titles / navigation here — avoids stubbing pericope groups in Record tab.

Also still depends on #407 (mode preference). Full pericope *recording* persistence remains #410.

### Test Results – Recording Controls

1. Verified that the **Current Unit Title** displays the active verse reference in Verse Mode.
2. Verified that the **Current Unit Title** displays the pericope verse range, with the pericope title as a subtitle when available.
3. Verified that a **“Pericope 1 of 7”** style counter is not displayed in the Current Unit Title.
4. Verified that **verse-level tick marks** are displayed on the draft waveform in Verse Mode and per-verse scrubbing is available.
5. Verified that **Pericope Mode** displays a continuous scrubber without tick marks, allowing position-based scrubbing.

### Issues Identified

1. **Next Pericope Navigation Issue:**
   When the user switches to **Pericope View**, the Record tab displays the verses belonging to the current pericope. However, clicking the **Next** button does not move to the next pericope set. The next pericope appears only after navigating through all the verses of the current pericope.

2. **Source Bible Text Issue:**
   In Pericope View, the **Source Bible text does not display the complete current pericope**. Only the first verse of the pericope is displayed instead of all verses included in the current pericope set.

3. **Pericope Recording and Scrubbing Issue:**
   When the user records multiple verses in **Pericope Mode**, the recording is displayed as a single audio unit. It is difficult for the user to scrub through the waveform and locate or verify a specific verse. Additionally, clicking on the waveform causes the audio to start from the beginning instead of starting from the selected position.

4. **Pericope-to-Verse View Recording Issue:**
   When the user switches from **Pericope View to Verse View**, a recording covering multiple verses is displayed only under the first verse. The remaining verses appear without recordings.

### Suggestion

1. **Improve Audio Waveform Scrubbing:**
   Add a clear **audio progress/playhead indicator** to the recorded audio waveform so users can easily identify the current playback position and scrub to the required point within the recording.

Moving this ticket to in progress Dev
The issues Roslin identified need to be fixed. I will review again after those have been worked on.

Fixed issues identified(1 & 2) in Issue #540(PR #543).
4 will be in scope of #411.
And 3 will be fixed in 544.
